name: Tide Pass
subtitle: Prepaid time subscription
description: Example 10 — users buy time at a fixed per-second rate, cancel for a pro-rata refund, and lapsed revenue settles permissionlessly. No operator keys.
long_description: Prepaid pass-style subscriptions. Users send value and receive exactly value/rate seconds; renewals stack onto the existing expiry so no residual time is lost. Cancelling refunds the remaining seconds at the same rate — the buy and refund arithmetic are symmetric, so dust stays inside the contract and conservation holds exactly. The design problem solved here is liability accounting without iteration: a single global refund-reserve scalar upper-bounds what all active subscribers could claim, making operator revenue claimable as balance minus reserve in constant time. Revenue claims and lapsed-subscription settlement are permissionless — the payee never needs to act on-chain, and refunds stay open even under the emergency brake.

interface.description: Returns the constant marker value that identifies personal-test mode in the deploy policy.
Returns the guardian address that may engage the brake.
Returns the URI and document hash that describe the brake policy.
Returns the current brake level, the guardian address and the timestamp when the brake last changed.
Ends the caller's active subscription and refunds the remaining seconds at the fixed rate in native coin.
Lets a registered token report a receipt so the personal-test token cap is checked; only callable by the token itself in personal-test mode.
Sends the balance not reserved for refunds to the payee in native coin; anyone may trigger it.
Returns the balance that could currently be sent to the payee, being balance minus refund reserve.
Raises the brake to a stronger level (1 or 2) to block new entries; only the guardian may call it and it cannot be lowered.
Returns the text 'personal-test' if this instance was deployed under a personal-test policy, otherwise 'testnet'.
Returns whether the address has an unexpired subscription.
Returns the address that receives subscription revenue.
Returns whether the given account is on the personal-test allow list for this instance.
Returns the policy authority address used to recognize allowed sibling instances, or zero outside personal-test mode.
Returns true if this instance was deployed in personal-test mode with access and value caps.
Returns the maximum native coin balance this instance may hold in personal-test mode, or 0 if disabled.
Returns the owner address of the personal-test policy, or zero if personal-test mode is off.
Returns the personal-test policy tuple: marker, owner address, native cap and token cap.
Returns the maximum token amount this instance may hold in personal-test mode, or 0 if disabled.
Returns the price in wei per second of subscription.
Returns the sum of active subscribers' paid amounts held back for possible refunds.
Adds or removes an account on the personal-test allow list; only the personal-test owner may call it and the owner cannot be removed.
Releases an expired subscriber's paid amount from the refund reserve so it counts as revenue; anyone may call and no funds move.
Extends the caller's subscription by the seconds the sent native coin buys at the fixed rate; needs open brake.
Returns the subscriber record: expiry timestamp and amount contributed in the current streak.
